title: iron deficiency in women just changed…

segments.text: For women with low iron, things just changed. For decades, a ferritin level of 0 to 15 [music] nanograms per milliliter qualified as an iron deficiency. But the baseline was just [music] updated to 30. The old threshold of 15 is roughly the point where there's no [music] iron left in the bone marrow.

At that point, the tank is completely empty and most people are already anemic. So this change is really important for women. Around [music] 1/3 of women in the reproductive age are iron deficient. And that's why the old standard. [music] Iron deficiency symptoms might look like fatigue, brain fog, poor exercise tolerance, hair shedding, restless legs, and even cold intolerance. So if you think that you might have low [music] iron, discuss these markers with your doctors.
